reviews.comment: Dr. Gaynanova structures her class very well. Every homework has very clear grading rubric and there is no filler; each one demonstrates a real and practical application of the material being covered in class. She speaks from experience and the lectures are interesting.

Wonderful Professor. Really caring, tries to make sure you understand the subject. Has a clear and fair grading criteria, curves around median. Easy course and exams if you pay attention in class and work sincerely on homeworks!

Irina is an awesome prof for Stats 211! Lectures are straight-forward and she constantly asks the class if they understand what's going on. Amazingly helpful and loves to see you in her office hours. Her tests are incredibly easy as they come directly out of her practice problems. Put a decent effort into this class, and it's an easy A

TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. She is litterally the kindest, most helpful professor I've ever had! She genuinley cares about students. I made use of her office hours which she would answer questions on the practice problems (what she based her tests on). She makes you work for your grade, but it is totally doable! I highly suggest you take her!

AWESOME. AWESOME. AWESOME. Really cares about all of her students and sometimes curves depending on the median grade... Most questions are straightforward, she does not try to trick you but you have to know your material. Make the extra effort to go to her office hours because she will help you answer review questions, which can show up on an exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's honestly a really good prof considering how bad statistics can be. Do the practice problems because a lot of her exam material comes from the practice problems. She really cares about the students and that they understand the material. Will answer any questions during office hours as well.
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Irina is definitely the best Stat211 Prof. I don't want to say it's an easy class but if you have a good understanding of the material it's pretty easy. Irina likes conceptual stats more than just plug and chug with the calculator so that can be frustrating. 3 tests and 10 homeworks, that's your grade. Drops lowest homework. 10/10 would recommend.
